building.name: One Kearny
building.architect: William Curlett (1902 original); Clark & Beuttler with Charles Moore (1964 addition); Charles F. Bloszies (later addition)
building.completed_conflict: The 1902 Mutual Savings Bank Building by William Curlett is the historic core; a 1964 addition was designed by Clark & Beuttler with Charles Moore, and a further Bloszies-designed addition followed, with one secondary source (CommercialCafe) giving 2009 for that addition's completion.

historic_status.reason: Article 11 Conservation District, National Register Individual, Historic Resource Evaluation Response, Historic Survey Result

public_open_space.name: 1 Kearny St
public_open_space.description: This rooftop terrace has extensive views of Market St. as well as rooftop architecture of nearby buildings. Landscaping and bench seating support this space.
public_open_space.landscaping: Hedges and other types of plants.
public_open_space.restrooms: Yes. Must present ID to guard in lobby to get bathroom key.
public_open_space.accessibility: Indirect. Must enter lobby, sign in, and take elevator to roof.
public_open_space.signage: yes. Three signs: one in front window, one in elevator, and one on rooftop terrace.
